tokenizer: lowercase; identifiers indexed whole and split on '_' and camelCase; no stemming
indexed_text: chunk content only (no file path or symbol name)
hit_definition: at least one counted file is among the first top_k unique files
mrr_definition: mean 1/rank of the first counted file in the unique-file ranking (0 if none was retrieved); does not require every required file
latency_note: per query: tokenize the question + BM25 scoring over the in-memory index, after one untimed warm-up query
